title: Cloud Technical Solutions Engineer, Networking (English)
description:
This role requires you to work in a shift pattern or non\-standard work hours as required.This may include weekend work.  

In most instances,this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process hours as required.This may include weekend work.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
* Experience reading or debugging code with one of the following: Java, C, C\+\+, .NET, Python, Shell, Perl, or JavaScript.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting network infrastructure devices.
* Experience using techniques such as packet capture/packet analysis, artificial packet creation, load testing, and traffic path analysis to troubleshoot network latency, packet loss, and other performance issues at the packet level.
* Experience with any of these cloud solutions: SQL database administration, Google App Engine, open source software communities, Cloud networking solutions, or distributed computing technology.
* System/network administrator level knowledge of Linux/Unix systems.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, Routing, VPNs, VLANs, Peering, Load Balancing, etc.).
* Knowledge of basic web technologies (HTTP, HTML, DNS, TCP, etc.).

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will own large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to other support teams.You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers make the switch to Google Cloud.  

  

In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and coding/scripting. You will make products easier to adopt by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Your team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for customers issues.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage the customer’s problems through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop knowledge of Google's product technology and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, determining the root cause for customer reported issues, and building tools for faster diagnosis.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Understand customer issues and advocate for their needs with cross\-functional teams including product and engineering teams to find ways to improve the product, and drive high\-quality production.

**Job Title: ServiceNow Architect**

**About the Role**


We are looking for a ServiceNow Architect to lead the overall design, architecture, and governance of the ServiceNow platform. This role requires deep hands‑on experience across multiple ServiceNow products, strong understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to guide development teams while working closely with process owners, business leaders, and technical stakeholders. You will define standards, design scalable solutions, and ensure the platform supports long‑term business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end‑to‑end architecture of the ServiceNow platform across ITSM, CMDB, and at least one additional product such as ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps.
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with platform best practices and organizational standards.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, data models, workflows, and integrations.
* Lead technical design sessions, solution reviews, and architecture discussions with developers and stakeholders.
* Oversee complex configurations: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Flow Designer logic.
* Guide integration design using Scripted REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and external systems.
* Ensure CMDB structure, relationships, and data quality support service mapping and operational processes.
* Support platform upgrades, patching, regression testing, and long‑term platform roadmap planning.
* Troubleshoot high‑impact issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and recommend permanent fixes.
* Provide technical leadership to developers and administrators; review code and ensure adherence to standards.
* Define governance, naming conventions, documentation practices, and development guidelines.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure compliance and platform stability.
* Drive automation, workflow optimization, and platform performance improvements.
* Maintain clear documentation for designs, integrations, data models, and architectural decisions.

**Core Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, tables, ACLs, and role‑based access.
* knowledge of Data Fabric and Creator Pro addon.
* Strong expertise in ITSM, ITAM and ITOM (required).
* Hands‑on experience with at least two additional modules: ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps, SPM, or ATF.
* Advanced scripting skills: JavaScript (server and client), Glide APIs, Script Includes, and UI scripting.
* Strong knowledge of Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, and process automation.
* Experience designing and maintaining Scripted REST APIs, integrations, and data exchange patterns.
* Solid understanding of CMDB relationships, discovery patterns, service mapping, and data governance.
* Familiarity with Service Portal, widgets, and UI customization.
* Understanding of ATF for automated testing.
* Strong grasp of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow modules.
* Experience with Scoped Apps, custom tables, and application lifecycle management.

**Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of hands‑on ServiceNow experience, including development and administration.
* Proven experience designing enterprise‑level ServiceNow solutions.
* Strong understanding of platform best practices, architecture principles, and governance.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS (ITSM/CMDB/HRSD), or CTA are preferred.
* Ability to mentor developers and admins and lead technical discussions.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.

*JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.*

Technical Experience

* Direct Routing
* Operator Connect
* Enterprise Voice
* VoIP and telephony solutions
* Deep understanding of Teams service architecture, performance optimisation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Call Quality Dashboard (CQD), Call Analytics, and reporting.
* Must have excellent technical troubleshooting and PowerShell scripting skills.
* Support hybrid environments and cloud enterprise solutions with Direct Routing planning, AudioCodes, SBC, and SIP trunking.
* Hands\-on experience deploying hybrid and cloud\-based Enterprise Voice solutions.
* Experience planning, designing, and deploying:
* AudioCodes SBC

* SIP trunks
* PSTN connectivity

Professional Attributes  

* Must have knowledge of Active Directory and Azure AD Connect.
* Strong stakeholder management and client\-facing consulting skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently lead workshops, assessments, and solution design sessions.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Experience leading technical teams and mentoring junior engineers.
* Excellent communication.
* Presentation skills.
* Flexible to work in shifts.


Preferred Certifications  

* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer Expert (MS\-721\)
* Microsoft 365 Certified Administrator
* AudioCodes SBC Certifications
* ITIL Foundation


Experience

* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

* **Microsoft Certified: Security Administrator Associate**
* **Microsoft Certified: Teams Administrator Associate**
* **ITIL Foundation Certification** (for incident/problem management processes)
* **CompTIA Security\+** or equivalent (for compliance/security awareness)

That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
